_meta.description: Flag register. Status: open | resolved | standing. Open flags are published on the Flagged for Review page and do not block publication. Every flag carries an evidence link. IDs F-01…F-67 are carried from the prior project registers (S-PRIOR3, S-PRIOR4) with their evidence; F-Pxx are new in this project.

flags.title: Product-level commission rate is unverified
flags.detail: The official Standard Commission Income Statement Table 1 lists Kitchen at 4.50% and Home at 3.00%. No official source reviewed maps these ASINs to a commission category, so every product-level rate is published blank. Do not infer a rate from the category band.
flags.how_to_resolve: Read the product-level rate from an Associates Central report after enrollment (owner action).

flags.title: Prices and star ratings are not published
flags.detail: Prices, ratings and review counts change constantly and would need a dated-snapshot discipline this site has not adopted (see D-19 for the evidence rule). They are visible on every listing and were observed during verification, but are withheld from all published pages. The site compares formats and listed specifications instead.
flags.evidence_note: S-P1; standing editorial rule carried from the prior register
flags.how_to_resolve: Owner decision: adopt a dated-snapshot price policy (queued as suggestion SG-05) or keep the rule.

flags.title: Supplied short links carry no tag= parameter
flags.detail: Every observed redirect of the five owner-supplied short links shows Amazon source-token parameters but no tag= parameter. Without an enrolled tag the clicks cannot be attributed. The site therefore publishes tagged Special Links built from the verified ASINs (D-01/D-14), and claims no attributed click or order.
flags.how_to_resolve: Run the one-link-per-product test in Associates Central (F-58).

flags.title: P3 belongs to a 6/8/9-quart size-variant family
flags.detail: Four GTINs are listed on the B08DKYBTPH page, confirming a size-variant family. A buyer (or a cart) can end up with a different size than the 8 qt record published here.
flags.how_to_resolve: None needed for publication; buyers are warned on the product row.

flags.title: Popularity and 'trending' claims need dated snapshots
flags.detail: Per decision D-19, a popularity claim is allowed only as a dated snapshot of an official page (page + read date named in the copy). Bare adjectives like 'trending' or 'best-selling' are banned from the copy rules.
flags.how_to_resolve: Standing rule; enforced by tools/checks.py word blacklist.

flags.title: Analytics endpoint is deployable but not yet hosted
flags.detail: GitHub Pages is static hosting. The privacy-preserving counter (docs/assets/js/measure.js) and the self-hosted endpoint (analytics-endpoint/server.py) ship with the site, but no server is deployed and settings.analytics_endpoint is empty, so the site sends nothing anywhere. Browser-local counts are visible to each visitor only and are not shared data.
flags.how_to_resolve: Host server.py somewhere owner-controlled, set settings.analytics_endpoint, rebuild (owner action; see measurement page).

flags.title: P2's listing states its cooking-function count in two ways
flags.detail: Listing sections have described the B09B7SB46R as having 24 cooking functions / 24 one-touch presets, while another count of 25 appeared in prior reads of a different section. The site publishes '24 as listed' with the read date and never a synthesized number.
flags.how_to_resolve: Count the presets on the listing during a dated re-read (any session).

flags.title: 'Also viewed' carousels change between reads
flags.detail: Carousel membership and order on the three air-fryer listings changed again on the 2026-11-19 read (P1 slots 2/3 swapped vs 2026-11-14; P3 slot 2 replaced). Carousel data is stored as dated observations only and is never presented as a stable 'competitor set'.
flags.how_to_resolve: Standing volatility; re-read on each verification pass.

flags.title: P2's listing title second segment drifts between reads
flags.detail: The B09B7SB46R listing title's second segment changed across the 2026-11-14, 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-19 reads. The site publishes the current string with its read date and keeps previous strings in the register (see also F-66).
flags.evidence_note: S-P2; strings recorded in data/p2/verification-2026-11-19.json and data/p2/products.json
flags.how_to_resolve: Standing volatility; the register keeps the dated history.

flags.title: Default offers can be used items (Amazon Resale)
flags.detail: On the 2026-11-16 reads the default offers on B0CDY277D3 and B08DKYBTPH were used items sold by Amazon Resale. Buyers should check the seller and condition on the listing. Not re-observed on the 2026-11-19 read.
flags.how_to_resolve: Standing buyer warning.

flags.title: Two newly submitted short links were unverified — resolved 2026-11-19
flags.detail: The brief's two additional links (link.amazon/B0c8moW59, link.amazon/B0f3GKalj) were unresolved at the time of the prior register (they were excluded from product pages then — that exclusion did not mean either was invalid). The 2026-11-19 session resolved both: B0DHZTCNR5 (ThermoMaven 1-sec thermometer) and B0DZFD6R9Z (CHEF iQ Sense Gen3), read their official listings, and added them to the register as P4/P5. Product-intent records for all five links remain separate from observed redirects.
flags.how_to_resolve: Resolved 2026-11-19. Attribution of these links remains governed by F-57/F-58.

flags.title: Tracking ID registration is confirmable only inside Associates Central
flags.detail: The owner supplied shopnow047c-20 and its format matches the documented US Store ID pattern (ends in -20). Whether it is registered, active, and belongs to an enrolled account cannot be confirmed from outside Associates Central. Until then the site publishes the links but claims no attributed click, order or revenue.
flags.how_to_resolve: Owner logs into Associates Central and confirms the Partner Tag (Q-01).

flags.title: One-link-per-product Associates test not yet run
flags.detail: The enrolled-workflow test (generate/validate one Special Link per product, confirm destination and a test click in the reporting) gates attribution claims and scaling — not publication. It cannot run from a build sandbox.
flags.how_to_resolve: Owner runs the test per the protocol on the measurement page.

flags.title: P2 title-segment drift (prior-register instance)
flags.detail: Prior instance of F-44: the stored second title segment dated 2026-11-14 differed from the 2026-11-15 read. Carried for history; the 2026-11-19 read extended the drift record again.
flags.how_to_resolve: Merged into F-44 going forward; kept for the dated trail.

flags.title: Short-link path codes are not ASINs
flags.detail: Amazon defines an ASIN as a 10-character alphanumeric identifier appearing after /dp/ in the product URL (S-ASIN). The submitted path codes (e.g. B04G1MEwY) are nine characters and live in the short-link path. They are recorded as link_path_code only and are never used as ASINs.
flags.how_to_resolve: Standing rule.

flags.title: P4's page shows two different waterproofing subtitle strings
flags.detail: The B0DHZTCNR5 page <title> says 'IP67 Waterproof for Grill BBQ' while the Product Summary heading on the same page says 'Highly Waterproof for Grill BBQ Camping'. Both are recorded verbatim; published copy uses the <title> string with its 2026-11-19 read date and states IP67 only as 'listed in the title'.
flags.how_to_resolve: Confirm the certified IP rating from the manufacturer's documentation if it becomes available (owner).

flags.title: Product scope: thermometers joined an air-fryer catalog — resolved 2026-11-19
flags.detail: The owner's brief lists five products to market; three resolve to air fryers and two (resolved 2026-11-19) to meat thermometers. The publication organizes them by format under one kitchen theme (countertop cooking + doneness tools) per decision D-P01. Not an irregularity in the data — recorded so the scope change is visible.
flags.how_to_resolve: Resolved by D-P01 (2026-11-19).

flags.title: P1 capacity unit wording differs between title and spec table
flags.detail: The B0CDY277D3 title states 6 Quart (2 × 3Qt baskets); the spec table read 2026-11-14 states '6 liters'. 6 qt is about 5.7 L, so the two wordings are not equal. Published copy uses the title wording with its read date; both readings are recorded.
flags.evidence_note: S-P1; title read 2026-11-19, spec table read 2026-11-14
flags.how_to_resolve: Re-read the spec table in a dated session and record whichever the listing shows.

flags.title: P5 is a size-variant listing (1/2/3/4 probes)
flags.detail: The B0DZFD6R9Z listing offers 1/2/3/4-probe configurations. This record is the 3-probe Gen3 configuration shown in the title. Buyers should confirm the probe count in the variant selector.
flags.how_to_resolve: Standing buyer warning.

flags.title: Two registers disagree on whether prices are published
flags.detail: data/products.json (the earlier Countercraft build) carries buy-box prices for all five ASINs (as listed on 2026-11-19; values are kept in that file only). data/p2/ withholds prices and ratings entirely (F-02). The earlier build's executive-summary appendix therefore conflicts with this build's rule. The Prod2 site publishes no prices.
flags.evidence_note: Price text as observed on the official listing, read 2026-11-19 (arena/236bc1ed-prod2 recheck).
flags.how_to_resolve: Decision under Q-27 / SG-05. Until a dated-snapshot rule is adopted and automated, prices stay unpublished here. The Countercraft build stays archived and is not mirrored.

flags.title: Short-link redirect re-read covered two of five links in the latest pass
flags.detail: This session re-fetched link.amazon/B04G1MEwY (resolves to B0CDY277D3) and link.amazon/B0c8moW59 (resolves to B0DHZTCNR5). Both matched the register. The other three short links (P2, P3, P5) keep their 2026-11-19 reads and were not re-fetched in this pass.
flags.evidence_note: Submitted link for P2; the three unrefreshed short links are listed in data/p2/intent-links.json.
flags.how_to_resolve: Re-read all five short links in the next publishing pass. Not automated yet; a check that fails on a redirect change would close this gap.

flags.title: Session-8ff10f50 dimension values not re-confirmed in this pass
flags.detail: This session (arena/8ff10f50-prod2) could not re-read the official Amazon listings to confirm the product-table dimensions (D×W×H) and derived capacity-per-depth ratio for P1-P3 — the sandbox cannot reach amazon.com (egress is github.com, npm and PyPI only). Those values carry earlier read dates (2026-11-14) and are published with them, pending an owner re-read. Per the publication rule, values that cannot be confirmed from an official source at publishing time should be left blank and flagged rather than trusted by default; no value was inferred or filled in this pass.
flags.how_to_resolve: Owner re-reads the three air-fryer listings and either re-confirms the dimensions (update read date) or blanks them and marks them unverified until confirmed.
